```{r}
library(EmbryoR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
x <- matrix(seq_len(60),5,dimnames=list(paste0("g",1:5),paste0("c",1:12)))
a <- SingleCellExperiment(assays=list(X=x))
b <- a;SummarizedExperiment::assay(b,"X") <- x+1
pred <- pseudobulk_shift(a,b,c(8.5,9.5),10.5)
validate_contract(pred,rownames(a))
plot_gene(pred,"g1")
```

This is synthetic demonstration data. For real T1: read E8.5/E9.5, intersect and order both files using the **board panel**, check the released log-normalised scale, then extrapolate to E10.5. Use actual board limits (1000–5118 cells in the 2026-10-11 snapshot) and resample if needed. Check gene order and run `write_submission`; h5ad I/O requires zellkonverter. A pseudobulk shift cannot create missing descendant populations. Never train on excluded held-out-stage measurements.
